p1_b0.ocr: In the Glencore mining and metals report for the Asia-Pacific region, water usage intensity is measured in m3/tonne across operational sites, which total 5, with an average intensity of 12.3 for the years 2020, 2021, and 2022. p1_b1.ocr: The rehabilitation provisions for the year 2020 were valued at 500M INR, with a yearly overview indicating a 10% change and a 20% market share, while closure provisions for the same year totaled 300M INR, reflecting a 5% change and a steady market share. The total provisions for 2020 reached 800M INR, with a year-on-year change of 7.5% and an 18% market share. Analysis of the years 2020, 2021, and 2022 indicates an overall growth of 8.5%, with sector performance remaining stable.
